exact_blockers: The exact FastEnhancer-L artifact is absent and its identity is unpinned. No linked asset-ledger row, release digest, rights entry or local file records a byte count or SHA-256 for a Large checkpoint or ONNX graph. Every fixed probe (data/models/fastenhancer/fastenhancer_l.onnx, fastenhancer_l_spec.onnx, .pt, .pth, cpp-library/.deps/fastenhancer_l.onnx and Pro large paths) is absent. The pinned MIT source checkout contains only the Large training config configs/fastenhancer/l.yaml and export code; source presence is not a weight, graph or runtime artifact.

The exact pinned runtime is absent. adapters/fastenhancer/requirements.lock pins CPython 3.10 macOS arm64 with onnxruntime==1.20.1 (wheel SHA-256 e50ba5ff7fed4f7d9253a6baf801ca2883cc08491f9d32d78a80da57256a5439) and the adapter records data/envs/dtln-onnx as its evaluator environment; neither is present here, and onnxruntime is not importable in the evidence interpreter. No exact-runtime reference run or parity vector was produced.

Rights are not cleared for a Large artifact. The source repository is MIT, but the release page records no separate pretrained-model terms and neither the linked asset ledger nor the rights register has a Large entry; the rights register records only fastenhancer_m, fastenhancer_s, fastenhancer_t and fastenhancer_t_16k. Evaluation, acquisition, redistribution, customer deployment and public playback for Large are unestablished.

No exact reference parity, candidate output, rights-cleared paired cohort, independent scorer, listening result or target-runtime timing exists. The documented Large VBD metrics are author-reported provenance only. The synthetic delayed-causal surrogate is not FastEnhancer-L and cannot qualify the candidate. All eight release gates remain blocked.

The documented Large geometry is the 16 kHz VoiceBank-Demand path (100-sample hop, 512-point FFT, 412-sample content delay, seven caches), not the installed v0 160-sample frame and not the 256-hop 16 kHz DNS Tiny/Small geometry. No v0 frame adapter, resampler or native engine is implemented or claimed.
